author: reek
body: The stocked database of business ideas. Every idea is a typed record, not a sentence: a seed carries its name, its vertical, its concept, and its monetization scheme as separate fields, so the engine can honor prompt invariants by filtering on structure instead of grepping prose. The verticals span the full gamut of human ambition, from crypto gambling through Las Vegas gambling through Wall Street gambling all the way to businesses that are, technically, legitimate.

author: reek
body: A Vertical names the market a seed belongs to. The vertical-id gives each variant a stable small integer so prompt constraints can be carried as plain data, and vertical-label renders the human name.

author: reek
body: Twenty-four seeds. Five crypto, four vegas, four wall street, three sports, eight legitimate. Every vertical is non-empty, which the engine relies on when it filters by prompt constraint.

author: reek
body: The free dimensions the engine fills in when the prompt does not pin them: platform, implementation language, a twist, and an audience.
